s2.body: Set the specification and quantity the deal asks for, such as a minimum quantity or a product type.

s3.title: Pick coupons in the cart
s3.body: Coupons that apply to your cart show in the order summary. Up to {max} work together.
s3.bodyNoMax: Coupons that apply to your cart show in the order summary, and several can work together.

combine.q: Can I use several coupons at once?
combine.a: Up to {max} per order. Coupons in the same group, such as two product discounts, work one at a time; the cart says which ones do not combine.
combine.aNoMax: Yes, up to the number the cart allows. Coupons in the same group, such as two product discounts, work one at a time; the cart says which ones do not combine.

wallet.q: Where are the coupons I keep?
wallet.a: In your account's coupon wallet; they appear in the cart's order summary when they apply to what is in it.

how.q: How is the discount worked out?
how.a: Each deal states its conditions and its maximum on the ticket. The actual discount is calculated in the cart and always shown before you pay.

auto.q: How do deals without a code work?
auto.a: There is nothing to enter. When your cart matches the conditions, the discount shows at checkout.
